comparison.objective: Coordinate with a human to sort objects without duplicating work; candidate commissions a mechanical shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Sorting tests collaborative selection and placement under unpredictable human choices. Candidate tests fine tool alignment, rotational adjustment, locking torque, and physical response evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Sorting requires avoiding duplicate selections; candidate requires quantified stopping behavior and a locked, drift-resistant setting. Sorting setup and scoring are missing.
comparison.reason: Human-aware task allocation is unrelated to mechanical damper tuning.
